title: MiniQMT strategy ledger keeps filled buy cash frozen and leaves strategy market_value zero
description:
Expected: After MiniQMT fills are synchronized, AIstock strategy ledger must settle buy fills exactly once: reduce or release the corresponding frozen cash, record actual fill cash movement/fees, create or update lot positions, compute strategy-level market_value/unrealized_pnl from lots and latest prices, and expose accurate per-strategy cash/equity/PnL. Filled buy notional must not remain indefinitely in frozen_cash.
Actual: 2026-05-19 MiniQMT SIM Strategy A has 20 accepted buy orders, 165 BUY fills, total traded quantity 134,600 and amount 3,979,087.54. qmt_strategy.trade_ledger has 165 rows and qmt_strategy.position_lot has 165 OPEN lots, but qmt_strategy.virtual_account for strategy_id=qmt_pocD_A2a9_132553 still shows cash=6,028,220.000000, frozen_cash=3,971,780.000000, market_value=0.000000, realized_pnl=0, unrealized_pnl=0. qmt_strategy.cash_ledger contains only 20 FREEZE_BUY rows and no fill-settlement/unfreeze rows. This means filled buys remain virtually frozen and strategy-level market value/PnL are not updated after broker fills are synchronized.
reproduce_command: GET /api/v1/qmt/status && GET /api/v1/qmt/trades && POST /api/v1/qmt/virtual-strategies/sync-snapshot with {"account_id":"62266303","trade_date":"2026-05-19"}; then query qmt_strategy.virtual_account, qmt_strategy.cash_ledger, qmt_strategy.trade_ledger and qmt_strategy.position_lot for strategy_id='qmt_pocD_A2a9_132553'.
required_verification: Unit tests cover full-fill, partial-fill, cancel/reject, and repeated sync idempotency for cash settlement.
After sync, filled BUY notional no longer remains indefinitely in frozen_cash.
Strategy summary total_equity, cash, frozen_cash, market_value, realized_pnl, and unrealized_pnl match lot ledger and cash ledger.
Same-symbol multi-strategy holdings are computed from strategy lots, not duplicated from MiniQMT account-level merged positions.
closure_requirements: Filled BUY orders create auditable cash settlement entries or equivalent canonical cash ledger events.
Open and partially filled orders keep only the truly unfilled amount frozen.
Rejected or cancelled BUY orders release remaining frozen cash exactly once.
Regression tests prevent cash/market_value/PnL from staying at pre-fill values after sync.

events.note: Evidence: API /qmt/trades summary has 165 BUY fills for strategy_name=pocD_A2a9_132553, total volume 134600, amount 3979087.54.
Evidence: DB qmt_strategy.order_intent/order_ledger/trade_ledger/position_lot counts for qmt_pocD_A2a9_132553 are 20/20/165/165.
Evidence: DB qmt_strategy.virtual_account for qmt_pocD_A2a9_132553 still has frozen_cash=3971780 and market_value=0 after sync.
Risk: blocks accurate independent per-strategy PnL/cash, may incorrectly block later buys or mislead multi-strategy validation.
This is separate from BUG-048 board-lot preflight; fixing board-lot validation alone does not correct cash/position/PnL settlement.
